BC_description:
The allowed values for the 'encoding' option in execa calls have been changed and some behaviors updated: 1) Support for 'encoding: null' has been removed entirely; use 'encoding: "buffer"' instead. 2) The allowed string values for 'encoding' have been renamed: 'utf-8'/'UTF8' are now 'utf8', 'utf-16le'/'ucs2'/'ucs-2' are now 'utf16le', and 'binary' is now 'latin1'. 3) When setting 'encoding: "buffer"', the returned 'stdout' and 'stderr' are now 'Uint8Array' instead of Node.js 'Buffer'.

Migrating to this version requires updating all calls to execa (including execaSync and asynchronous execa) that use any of the affected 'encoding' values, and adapting code that consumes 'stdout'/'stderr' for 'buffer' encoding outputs from Buffer to Uint8Array.
